name: security-canvas
description: Cross-pillar agent security triage for a Microsoft tenant. Inventories the agents in your estate, explains why Entra flagged one as risky, weighs identity risk against Purview data exposure and GitHub code access, and hands back a Purview DLP playbook.

client_id.title: Entra app registration (client ID)
client_id.description: Leave blank to use the app registration shipped with the plugin. Set this to your own public-client app registration if your tenant requires it. The app must declare the delegated Microsoft Graph scope IdentityRiskyAgent.Read.All and register http://localhost as a redirect URI.

tenant_id.title: Entra tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Leave blank to sign in against any work or school account ('organizations'). Set a tenant GUID or domain to pin sign-in to one tenant.
